name: Lightning Thrower (wiki Damage_mechanics worked example)
_note: Reproduces bg3.wiki Damage_mechanics Example Calculation. Expected ~36 avg damage on a hit (ignoring resistances, pre hit-probability). Setup: 20 Str, Tavern Brawler, Lightning Charges (+1 lightning DR), Ring of Flinging (+1d4 piercing DR), Hex (+1d6 necrotic DR), Lightning Jabber thrown weapon (1d6+1+5 piercing DS, +1d4 lightning DRS from weapon passive).
